mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing demand in the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 70% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < 0% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy in a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 70% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals growing consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 70% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.
